risk_note: RV1 (risk). B1-03zo (D10-1401): the dashboard card appeal_pending gets a per-app read-only count exported by risk — countProcessingAppeals(db, appId). The one predicate processingAppealOf(appId) (app_id = ? AND status = 'processing', status as a literal so appeals_processing_deadline_idx stays usable) is shared by the new count and by the console appeal list's status=processing filter, overdue filter and counts (processing / overdue / closed); no target_type, deadline or source filter; no writes. The implementation was a fresh desktop Claude subagent (model opus) in place of claude -p on the terminal accounts, which are no longer usable (DESKTOP-common-20261113).
